name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-08-05, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.77 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
